subject: Math
prompt: A new car is purchased for $$24,000$. The car depreciates $$1,000$ every year. The function $D$ represents the car's value, in dollars, $t$ years after its purchase. If $D(t-2)=22,000-1,000t$ for all values of $t$, what is the value, in dollars, of $D(3)$?
explanation: To find $D(3)$, we need to determine which value of $t$ makes $t-2=3$. Solving this gives $t=5$. Substituting $t=5$ into the given equation $D(t-2)=22{,}000-1{,}000t$ yields $D(3)=22{,}000-1{,}000(5)=22{,}000-5{,}000=17{,}000$. Therefore, $D(3)=17{,}000$.
